finding: A browser layout clamp can decrease scrollTop while the transcript remains at the geometric end. The old helper interprets every decrease as upward intent and stops following subsequent output.
fix: Compare scrollTop against min(lastScrollTop,max(0,scrollHeight-clientHeight)) for upward movement. Preserve the existing explicit wheel/key release and downward-to-end re-entry behavior.

observations.originalIntegration: No assertions changed. The exact original intermittent composer-triggered failure was not independently established; the final regression includes the same long second draft and 70-paragraph response, and demonstrates a controlled native viewport clamp.
observations.padding: Real padding shrink clamps scrollTop, but history ResizeObserver can repair lastScrollTop before the queued scroll event. Padding-only runs therefore depend on observer timing.
observations.viewport: After pending follow RAFs settle, increasing native content height by 80 leaves history height unchanged, reduces reachable scrollTop by 80, and reliably reproduces the old-helper failure on subsequent streamed output.
